declarations.name: AuiDateInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI DateInput: `<aui-date-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name for the ISO 8601 hidden input.

inputs.name: disambiguation
inputs.description: DST policy for nonexistent/ambiguous local times.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: User edit changed the value or validity.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: setLocalValue
methods.description: Minute granularity, for composite controls: write a wall-clock date-time resolved as if typed (timezone, disambiguation, DST hint or error). No aui-change.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user changes the value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 value (YYYY-MM-DD or instant with Z), or null when empty or invalid.

accessibility.pattern: Labelled group of labelled text inputs (segmented date field). No APG pattern exists for segmented date fields; native text inputs are used for maximum assistive technology compatibility.

limitations: Minute granularity only; seconds are not editable.
Timezone rule accuracy depends on the browser's ICU data (SPEC section 8.7).
Incomplete and required errors are shown after the group loses focus or reportValidity() is called; other errors show immediately.
